_comment: A service reaches the callback given to Effect.effectify, whose declared type is a type parameter constrained to (...args: Array<any>) => any. The callback's parameters are open, so the service arrives: the method the callback reads stays and the unread one is removed. With effect 4.1.2 the constraint would not change this mask; the dts unit test constrained_callback_type_parameter_is_open guards deviation (4).
